scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dive/api && npm run build -w @dive/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @dive/api && npm run typecheck -w @dive/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @dive/api && npm run test -w @dive/web && npm run test -w @dive/mcp
